pose: The massive Deinocheirus is hunched over a muddy riverbank, its large sail-back silhouetted against the sun. One of its famous, 8-foot-long arms is bent, with the huge claws resting gingerly against the side of its duck-like snout. It is using its other hand to slowly sift through a pile of river reeds and wet stones. Its expression is focused and mildly bothered—eyes narrowed as it peers at the mud, and its mouth held slightly open in a tender 'O' shape to avoid biting down on the sore spot. It looks up toward the player with a hopeful, questioning tilt of the head.

visual_logic.substrate: Laminated sand and clay with ripples from the water

behavioral_intent: Earnest, heavy-set search. The dinosaur communicates its discomfort through slowed, deliberate movements and a direct 'help me' gaze directed at the player.
